question: Which products have never been ordered?
expected_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL;

question: Find the average order value across all completed orders.
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.id) sub;
